{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute response rates by sex within each arm, stratified by severity
response_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
response_by_sex_severity = response_by_sex_severity.pivot_table(index=['arm', 'sex'], columns='severity', values='responded', aggfunc='mean')
response_by_sex_severity = response_by_sex_severity.reset_index()

# Also compute overall response rates by sex and arm
overall_response = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()

# Display both
response_by_sex_severity, overall_response"}
